description: Modernize the Check utility class (src/Abp/Check.cs) to delegate to the .NET built-in ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull, ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrEmpty, and ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace guard methods (available since .NET 7). This replaces custom null/empty checking logic with framework-provided implementations that are optimized and produce consistent exception messages. The public API signatures remain the same to avoid breaking changes for downstream consumers.
steps: In src/Abp/Check.cs, refactor the NotNull<T> method to call ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(value, parameterName) instead of the manual if-null-throw pattern, then return value
In src/Abp/Check.cs, refactor NotNullOrEmpty(string) to call ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrEmpty(value, parameterName) instead of the manual check, then return value
In src/Abp/Check.cs, refactor NotNullOrWhiteSpace(string) to call ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(value, parameterName) instead of the manual check, then return value
Keep the NotNullOrEmpty<T>(ICollection<T>) overload as-is since there is no built-in equivalent for collection emptiness checks
Remove the 'using Abp.Extensions' and 'using Abp.Collections.Extensions' imports if they become unused after the refactoring
Run 'dotnet build Abp.sln' to verify no compilation errors
acceptance_criteria: The method signatures (return types, parameter types) remain unchanged
verification: Run 'dotnet build Abp.sln' and confirm zero build errors
Run 'dotnet test test/Abp.Tests/Abp.Tests.csproj --no-build' to verify Check tests pass
findings: Removed 'using Abp.Extensions' (no longer needed). Kept 'using Abp.Collections.Extensions' because it is still used by the NotNullOrEmpty<T>(ICollection<T>) overload. Build passes with 0 errors. All 1091 Abp.Tests pass. No dedicated Check tests exist in the test suite.
